_help: Copy to <dir>/xml-config.json. fps = the SEQUENCE frame rate; seqStart = where the camera clip starts on the new sequence (s); minPieceFrames = shortest kept piece (shorter slivers merge into the cut). cam.in/out = the part of the camera file to use (s); scale (and aspect) = Premiere Motion values as in your own sequence (prproj-timeline.cjs prints them). voice = the voice as a mono WAV (the camera's mic channel; make it with ffmpeg, see README). scr = the screen recording kept in sync on V2 — delete the whole block if there is none; camOffset = camera seconds where screen second 0 sits. Absolute paths: Premiere looks for the media there.
